first: चौ०-मातु मोहि दीजै कछु चीन्हा । जैसे रघुनायक माहि दीन्हा।
en: Hanuman said, 'Mother, give me some token, just as Rama gave me one.' Then she took off her crest-jewel and gave it, and the Son of the Wind took it with joy.

first: कहेउ तात अस मोर प्रनामा । सब प्रकार प्रभु पूरनकामा ।
en: She said, 'Dear one, give my greetings to the Lord like this: Lord, you lack nothing in any way, but remember your name as the friend of the humble, and remove my great distress.'

first: तात सक्र-सुत कथा सुनायेहु । बान प्रताप प्रभुहि समुझायेहु ।।
en: 'Dear one, tell him the story of Indra's son, and remind the Lord of the power of his arrow. If my Lord does not come within a month, he will not find me alive.'

first: कहु कपि केहि बिधि राखउँ प्राना । तुम्हहूँ तात कहत अब जाना।
en: 'Tell me, monkey, how am I to keep myself alive? You too, dear one, now speak of leaving. Seeing you my heart was soothed; now the same days and the same nights await me again.'

first: दो०-जनक-सुतहि समुझाइ करि, बहु बिधि धीरज दीन्ह ।
en: The monkey comforted Janaka's daughter and gave her courage in many ways. Then he bowed his head at her lotus feet and set off to go to Rama.

first: चौ°—चलत महाधुनि गर्जेसि भारी । गर्भ स्रवहिँ सुनि निसिचर-नारी।
en: As he left he gave a mighty roar; hearing it, the demon women lost their unborn children. He leapt across the sea to this shore and let the monkeys hear his joyful shout.

first: दो॰—हरषे सब बिलोकि हनुमाना । नूतन जनम कपिन्ह तब जाना।
en: Everyone rejoiced to see Hanuman; the monkeys felt they had been born again. His face was glad and his body glowed; they knew he had done Rama's work.

first: मिले सकल अति भये सुखारी। तलफत मीन पाव जनु बारी ।
en: They all met him and were overjoyed, like a fish gasping for breath that finds water. They set off happily to Rama, asking and telling the fresh news.

first: तब मधुबन भीतर सब आये । अङ्गद सम्मत मधु-फल खाये ।।
en: Then they all went into the Madhuban grove and, with Angada's consent, ate the honey and fruit. When the guards tried to stop them, they struck them with their fists and all the guards ran away.

first: दो०-जाइ पुकारे ते सब, बन उजार जुबराज ।
en: The guards all went and cried out, 'The prince is wrecking the grove!' Hearing this, Sugriva rejoiced: 'The monkeys have done the Lord's work.'

first: चौo-जौँ न होतिसीतासुधि पाई । मधुबन के फल सकहिँ कि खाई ॥
en: 'If they had not found news of Sita, would they dare to eat the fruit of Madhuban?' As the king thought this over, the whole band of monkeys arrived.

first: आइ सबहिँ नावा पद सीसा । मिले सबन्हि अति प्रीति कपीसा ।
en: They all came and bowed their heads at his feet, and the monkey king met them all with great love. He asked how they were. They said, 'Seeing your feet, all is well. By Rama's grace the task is done.'

first: नाथ काज कीन्हेउ हनुमाना । राखे सकल कपिन्ह के प्राना ॥
en: 'Lord, Hanuman did the task and saved the lives of all the monkeys.' Hearing this, Sugriva embraced him again and went with the monkeys to Rama.

first: राम कपिन्ह जब आवत देखा ! किये काज मन हरष बिसेखा ॥
en: When Rama saw the monkeys coming with the task done, he was very glad at heart. The two brothers were sitting on a crystal rock, and all the monkeys went and fell at their feet.

first: दो०-प्रीति सहित सब भेँटे, रघुपति करुना पुज्ज।
en: Rama, the store of compassion, met them all with love and asked how they were. They said, 'Lord, now that we see your lotus feet, all is well.'

first: चौ°—जामवन्त कह सुनु रघुराया । जा पर नाथ करहु तुम्ह दाया
en: Jambavan said, 'Listen, Rama: anyone on whom you show kindness, Lord, is always blessed and well, and gods, men and sages are pleased with him.'

first: सोइ बिजई बिनई गुन-सागर । तासु सुजस त्रय लोक उजागर
en: 'He is victorious, humble and an ocean of virtues, and his fame shines in the three worlds. By the Lord's grace all the work is done, and today our lives have borne fruit.'

first: नाथ पवन-सुत कीन्हि जो करनी । सहसहु मुख न जाइ सो बरनी ॥
en: 'Lord, what the Son of the Wind has done cannot be told even with a thousand mouths.' Then Jambavan told Rama the fine deeds of Hanuman.

first: सुनत कृपानिधि मन अति भाये । पुनि हनुमान हरषि हिय लाये।
en: Hearing them, the merciful Lord was very pleased, and he joyfully hugged Hanuman again. 'Tell me, dear one, how does Janaki live and keep herself alive?'

first: दो॰-नाम पाहरू दिवस निसि, ध्यान तुम्हार कपाट ।
en: Hanuman said, 'Your name is the guard on watch day and night, and thinking of you is the door. Her eyes are fixed on her feet like a lock; so by what way could her life escape?'

first: चौ°—चलत मोहि चूडामनि दीन्ही । रघुपति हृदय लाइ सोइ लीन्ही॥
en: 'As I left, she gave me this crest-jewel.' Rama took it and pressed it to his heart. Hanuman said, 'Lord, with both eyes full of tears, Janaka's daughter said a few words:'

first: अनुज समेत गहेहु प्रभु चरना । दीनबन्धु प्रनतारति हरना ।।
en: 'Hold the Lord's feet, and his brother's too, and say: friend of the humble, remover of the pain of those who bow to you, I love your feet in thought, deed and word; for what fault, Lord, have you abandoned me?'

first: अवगुन एक मोर मैं जाना। बिछुरत प्रान न कीन्ह पयाना
en: 'I know one fault of mine: when we were parted, my life did not leave me. But Lord, that is the fault of my eyes, which stubbornly block my life from leaving.'

first: बिरह अगिनि तनु तूल समीरा । स्वास जरइ छन माँह सरीरा॥
en: 'The fire of separation, my body like cotton, and my breath like wind would burn this body in a moment, but my eyes shed tears for their own sake, so the body cannot burn.'

first: सीता कै अति बिपति बिसाला । बिनहिँ कहें भलि दीनदयाला ॥५॥
en: 'Sita's suffering is very great; friend of the humble, it is better left unsaid.'

first: चौ०-निमिष निमिष करूनानिधि, जाहिँ कलप सम बीति ।
en: 'Ocean of mercy, each moment passes like an age. Come quickly, Lord, defeat the wicked army by the strength of your arms, and take me back.'

first: चौ०-सुनि सीता दुख प्रभु सुख अयना । भरि आये जल राजिव-नयना॥
en: Hearing of Sita's grief, the Lord, home of joy, filled his lotus eyes with tears. 'Can she who depends on me in word, body and mind ever know trouble, even in a dream?'

first: कह हनुमन्त विपत्ति प्रभु सोई। जब तब सुमिरन सजन न होई ॥
en: Hanuman said, 'Lord, the only real trouble is when one does not remember and worship you. What do the demons count for, Lord? You will defeat the enemy and bring Janaki back.'

first: सुनु कपि तोहि समान उपकारी। नहिं कोउ सुर नर मुनि तनु धारी॥
en: 'Listen, monkey: no god, man or sage who has taken a body has done me such a service as you. What can I give you in return? My mind cannot even face you.'

first: सुनु सुत तोहि उरिन मैं नाहीं । देखेउँ करि बिचार मन माहीं ॥
en: 'Listen, son, I have thought it over in my mind, and I can never repay my debt to you.' Again and again the protector of the gods gazed at the monkey, his eyes wet and his body thrilling.

first: दो॰—सुनि प्रभु बचन बिलोकि मुख, गात हरषि हनुमन्त ।
en: Hearing the Lord's words and seeing his face, Hanuman was filled with joy. Overcome with love, he fell at his feet, crying, 'Save me, save me, Lord!'

first: चौ°—बार बार प्रभु चहहिँ उठावा । प्रेम मगन तेहि उठब न भावा ।
en: Again and again the Lord tried to lift him up, but lost in love, Hanuman did not want to rise. The Lord's lotus hand was on the monkey's head; remembering that sight, Shiva, Gauri's lord, was lost in bliss.

first: सावधान मन करि पुनि सङ्कर । लागे कहन कथा अति सुन्दर
en: Then Shiva steadied his mind and went on telling the lovely story. The Lord raised the monkey, hugged him to his heart, took his hand and seated him very close.

first: कहु कपि रावन पालित लङ्का । केहि बिधि दहेउ दुर्ग अति बङ्का ।
en: 'Tell me, monkey, how did you burn Lanka, Ravana's well-guarded city and very strong fort?' Seeing the Lord pleased, Hanuman spoke without any pride:

first: साखामृग कै बड़ि मनुसाई । साखा तेँ साखा पर जाई ।
en: 'A monkey's great skill is just to jump from branch to branch. That I crossed the sea, burned the golden city, killed the demons and wrecked the grove,'

first: सो सब तव प्रताप रघुराई । नाथ न कछू मोरि प्रभुताई ॥५॥
en: 'all that was your glory, Rama; Lord, none of it was my own power.'

first: दो॰—ताकहँ प्रभु कछु अगम नहिँ, जापर तुम्ह अनुकूल।
en: 'Lord, nothing is hard for one you favour. By your power, cotton can surely burn up even the fire beneath the sea.'

first: चौ°—नाथ भगति अति सुखदायनी। देहु कृपा करि अनपायनी॥
en: 'Lord, in your mercy give me devotion that brings great joy and never fades.' Hearing the monkey's very simple words, Bhavani, the Lord said, 'So be it.'

first: उमा राम सुभाव जेहिं जाना । ताहि भजन तजि भाव न आना ॥
en: Uma, whoever has known Rama's nature cares for nothing but worshipping him. Whoever takes this conversation to heart gains devotion to Rama's feet.

first: सुनि प्रभु बचन कहहिँ कपि बृन्दा । जय जय जय कृपाल सुखकन्दा॥
en: Hearing the Lord's words, the monkeys cried, 'Victory, victory, victory to the merciful one, the source of joy!' Then Rama called Sugriva and told him to get ready to march.

first: अब बिलम्ब केहि कारन कीजै । तुरत कपिन्ह कह आयसु दीजै ॥
en: 'Why delay now? Give the order to the monkeys at once.' Watching this sight, the gods rained down many flowers and went happily from the sky to their homes.

first: कपिपति बेगि बोलाये, आये यूथप यूथ।
en: The monkey king quickly sent for them, and the troop leaders came with their troops: hosts of monkeys and bears of many colours and matchless strength.

first: चौ०-प्रभु पद-पङ्कज नावहिं सीसा। गर्जहिँ भालु महाबल कीसा ॥
en: They bowed their heads at the Lord's lotus feet, and the mighty bears and monkeys roared. Lotus-eyed Rama looked over the whole monkey army with a glance of grace.

first: राम कृपा बल पाइ कपिन्दा । भये पच्छजुत मनहुँ गिरिन्दा ॥
en: Gaining strength from Rama's grace, the great monkeys seemed like mountains that had grown wings. Then Rama joyfully set out, and many fine, lucky omens appeared.

first: जासु सकल मङ्गल-मय कीती । तासु पयान सगुन यह नीती ॥
en: For him whose fame is all blessing, it is fitting that good omens appear when he sets out. Sita knew of the Lord's march, for her left side throbbed, as if telling her so.

first: जोइ जोइ सगुन जानकिहि होई ।असगुन भयउ रावनहिँ सोई ॥
en: Every good omen that came to Janaki came as a bad omen to Ravana. Who could describe the army as it marched? Countless monkeys and bears roared.

first: नख आयुध गिरि पादप धारी ।चले गगन महि इच्छाचारी ॥
en: With nails as their weapons, carrying mountains and trees, they moved at will through the sky and over the land. The bears and monkeys roared like lions, and the elephants that hold up the four quarters shook and trumpeted.

first: दो०-एहि बिधि जाइ कृपानिधि,उतरे सागर तीर ।
en: In this way the merciful Lord went and camped on the seashore. Here and there the many brave bears and monkeys began eating fruit.

first: चौ०-उहाँ निसाचर रहहिं ससङ्का । जब तें जारि गयउ कपि लड्डा।
en: Over there the demons lived in fear ever since the monkey burned Lanka and left. In their homes they all thought, 'There is no saving the demon race.'

first: जासु दूत बल बरनि न जाई । तेहि आये पुर कवन भलाई ।
en: 'What good can come to the city when he arrives, whose messenger's strength is beyond words?' Hearing from her maids what the townsfolk were saying, Mandodari grew very anxious.

first: रहसि जोरि कर पति पद लागी । बोली बचन नीति-रस पागी॥
en: In private she joined her hands, fell at her husband's feet, and spoke words full of wisdom: 'My lord, give up this quarrel with Hari. Take my advice to heart, for it is for your good.'

first: समुझत जासु दूत कइ करनी। स्रवहिं गर्भ रजनीचर-घरनी॥
en: 'Just thinking of his messenger's deeds, the demon wives lose their unborn babies. My lord, if you want your own good, call your minister and send his wife back.'

first: तब कुल कमल-विपिन दुखदाई । सीता सीत-निसा सम आई ।
en: 'Sita has come like a winter night that brings ruin to the lotus grove of your family. Listen, lord: unless you give Sita back, even Shiva and Brahma cannot do you good.'

first: दो°-राम बान अहिगन सरिस, निकर निसाचर भेक ।
en: 'Rama's arrows are like a host of snakes and the demons like frogs. Before they swallow us, give up your stubbornness and take steps to save us.'

first: चौ°—स्रवन सुनी सठ ताकरिवानी। विहँसा जगतबिदित अभिमानी।
en: Hearing her words, the fool, known to the world for his pride, laughed: 'It is true what they say of a woman's nature: she is afraid even in good times, and her heart is very weak.'

first: जौँ आवइ मरकट कटकाई। जियहिँ विचार निसिचर खाई॥
en: 'If the monkey army comes, the poor demons will eat them and live. The guardians of the worlds tremble in fear of me, and my wife is afraid. That is a great joke!'

first: असकहि बिहँसि ताहि उर लाई। चलेउ समा ममता अधिकाई॥
en: Saying this, he laughed, hugged her, and went to his court with even more pride. Mandodari worried in her heart: 'Fate has turned against my husband.'

first: बैठेउ सभा खबरि असि पाई। सिन्धु पार सेना सब आई।
en: As he sat in court, news came that the whole army had come to the far shore of the sea. He asked his ministers to give proper advice. They all laughed: 'Stay calm and say nothing.'

first: जितेहु सुरासुर तब खम नाहीँ । नर बानर केहि लेख माहीं ॥३॥
en: 'You conquered gods and demons with no effort at all; what do men and monkeys count for?'

first: दो०-सचिव वैद गुरु तीनि जौँ, प्रिय बोलहिँ भय आस ।
en: If a minister, a doctor and a teacher speak only pleasing words out of fear or hope of reward, then the kingdom, the right conduct and the body, all three, are soon ruined.

first: चौ०-सोइ रावन कह बनी सहोई । अस्तुति करहिँ सुनाइ सुनाई ॥
en: So it was with Ravana: they all praised him to his face. Knowing the moment had come, Vibhishana arrived and bowed his head at his brother's feet.

first: पुनि सिर नाइ बैठ निज आसन । बोला बचन पाइ अनुसासन ॥
en: He bowed again, sat in his own seat, and when given leave, said, 'Since you kindly ask me, dear brother, I will tell you what is good, as far as I can understand.'

first: जो आपन चाहइ कल्याला । सुजस सुमति सुभगति सुख नाना ॥
en: 'Whoever wants his own welfare, good fame, a good mind, a good end and many joys, my lord, should shun another man's wife, as one shuns looking at the moon on the fourth day.'

first: चौदह भुवन एक पति होई । भूत-द्रोह तिष्ठइ नहिं सोई ॥
en: 'Even if one is the sole lord of the fourteen worlds, he cannot last if he harms living beings. Even a man who is an ocean of virtues and very clever is not called good if he has even a little greed.'

first: दो-काम क्रोध मद लाभ सब, नाथ नरक के पन्थ ।
en: 'Lust, anger, pride and greed, my lord, are all roads to hell. Give them all up and worship Rama, whom the saints worship.'

first: चौ०-तात राम नहिँ नर भूपाला । भुवनेश्वर कालहु कर काला ॥
en: 'Brother, Rama is not just a human king. He is the Lord of the worlds, the death of Death itself. He is God, the supreme spirit, free from sickness and unborn, all-pervading, unconquered, without beginning or end.'

first: गो द्विज धेनु देव हितकारी । कृपासिन्धु मानुष तनु धारी॥
en: 'He is the merciful one who has taken a human body for the good of the earth, the Brahmins, the cows and the gods. Listen, brother: he delights his people, destroys hosts of the wicked, and protects the Vedas and right conduct.'

first: ताहि बयर- तजि नाइय माथा प्रनतारति भञ्जन रघुनाथा ।।
en: 'Give up enmity with him and bow your head; Rama ends the pain of those who bow to him. My lord, give Sita back to the Lord, and worship Rama, who loves without any selfish reason.'

first: सरन गये प्रभु ताहु न त्यागा। बिस्व-द्रोह-कृत अघ जेहि लागा ..
en: 'The Lord does not cast off even one who has sinned against the whole world, if he comes for shelter. Ravana, know in your heart that he is that very Lord, whose name destroys the three kinds of suffering.'

first: दो०-बार बार पद लागउँ, बिनय करउँ दससीस ।
en: 'Ten-headed one, again and again I touch your feet and beg you: give up pride, delusion and arrogance, and worship the Lord of Kosala.'

first: 'मुनि पुलस्ति निज सिष्य सल, कहि पठई यह बात ।
en: 'Dear brother, the sage Pulastya sent this message through his disciple, and I have told it to you at once, finding a good moment.'

first: चौo-माल्यवन्त अतिसचिव सयाना। तासु बचन सुनि अति सुख माना॥
en: Malyavan, a very wise minister, was very pleased to hear his words and said, 'Dear one, your younger brother is a jewel of wisdom; take to heart what Vibhishana says.'

first: रिपु उतकर्ष कहत सठ दोऊ । दूरि न करहु इहाँ है कोऊ ॥
en: Ravana said, 'These two fools are praising the enemy. Is there no one here to send them away?' Then Malyavan went home, and Vibhishana spoke again with folded hands:

first: सुमति कुमति सब के उर रहहीं । नाथ पुरान निगम अस कहहीं।
en: 'Good sense and bad sense dwell in every heart, my lord; so say the Puranas and the Vedas. Where there is good sense, there is plenty of every kind; where there is bad sense, ruin follows in the end.'

first: तव उर कुमति बसी बिपरीता । हित अनहित मानहु रिपु प्रीता ॥
en: 'Bad, perverse sense has settled in your heart, so you take friends for foes and foes for friends. You are deeply in love with Sita, who is the night of doom for the demon race.'

first: दो॰—तात चरन गहि माँगउँ, राखहु मोर दुलार ।
en: 'Brother, I hold your feet and beg you, grant me this as your loved one: give Sita back to Rama, and no harm will come to you.'

first: चौ०-बुध-पुरान-स्रुति-सम्मत बानी। कही बिभीषन नीति बखानी ॥
en: Vibhishana spoke wise words, in keeping with the learned, the Puranas and the Vedas. Hearing them, Ravana rose up in anger: 'Wretch, your death is now near.'

first: जियसि सदा सठ मोर जियावा । रिपु कर पच्छ मूढ़ तोहि भावा ।
en: 'Fool, you have always lived by my favour, yet you like the enemy's side. Tell me, wretch, who in the world have I not conquered by the strength of my arms?'

first: मम पुर बसि तपसिन्ह पर प्रीती । सठ मिलु जाइ तिन्हहिँ कहु नीती॥
en: 'You live in my city but love the hermits. Fool, go and join them and teach them your wisdom.' Saying this, he kicked him, yet his brother clung to his feet again and again.

first: उमा सन्त कइ इहइ बड़ाई । मन्द करत जो करई भलाई ।
en: Uma, this is the greatness of a saint: he does good even to one who does him harm. Vibhishana said, 'You are like a father to me; you may strike me, but your good lies in worshipping Rama.'

first: सचिव सङ्ग लेइ नम-पथ गयऊ । सबहि सुनाइ कहत अस भयऊ ॥५॥
en: Taking his ministers with him, he went off by the path of the sky, and said aloud for all to hear:

first: दो॰—राम सत्यसङ्कल्प प्रभु, सभा काल-बस तोरि।
en: 'Rama is the Lord, whose will always comes true, and your court is in the grip of Death. I now go to Rama for shelter; do not blame me.'

first: चौ°—अस कहि चला बिभीषन जबहीं। आयू-हीन भये सब तबहीं ॥
en: As soon as Vibhishana left, they were all doomed to die. Bhavani, slighting a holy man at once ruins every kind of good.

first: रावन जबहिँ बिभीषन त्यागा । भयउ विभव बिनु तबहिँ अभागा ॥
en: The moment Ravana cast off Vibhishana, the luckless one lost his fortune. Vibhishana went joyfully to Rama, with many hopes in his heart:

first: देखिहउँ जाइ चरन-जलजाता ।अरुन मृदुल सेवक सुख-दाता ॥
en: 'I will go and see his lotus feet, red and soft, which bring joy to his servants; the feet whose touch saved the sage's wife, and which made the Dandaka forest holy.'

first: देखिहउँ जाइ चरन-जलजाता ।अरुन मृदुल सेवक सुख-दाता ॥
en: 'I will see those lotus feet, rosy and tender, the joy of his servants; the feet that freed the sage's wife at their touch and blessed the Dandaka forest.'

first: दो॰—जिन्ह पायन्ह के पादुकन्हि, भरत रहे मन लाइ।
en: 'Those feet whose sandals Bharata keeps his heart fixed on, those very feet I will now go and see today with these eyes.'

first: चौ०-एहि बिधि करत सप्रेम बिचारा । आयउ सपदि सिन्धु एहि पारा॥
en: Thinking these loving thoughts, he quickly reached this side of the sea. The monkeys saw Vibhishana coming and took him for some important enemy messenger.

first: ताहि राखि कपीस पहिँ आये । समाचार सब ताहि सुनाये।
en: They held him there and went to the monkey king and told him all the news. Sugriva said, 'Listen, Rama: Ravana's brother has come to meet you.'

first: कह प्रभु सखा बूझिये काहा । कहइ कपीस सुलहु नरनाहा ॥
en: The Lord said, 'Friend, what do you think?' The monkey king said, 'Listen, king of men: the tricks of demons cannot be known. Why has this shape-changer come?'

first: भेद हमार लेन सठ आवा । राखिय बांधि माहि अस भावो।
en: 'The fool has come to learn our secrets. I think we should keep him tied up.' Rama said, 'Friend, you have judged the rules of conduct well, but my vow is to remove the fear of those who seek my shelter.'

first: सुनि प्रभु बचन हरष हनुमाना । सरनागत बच्छल भगवाना ॥५॥
en: Hearing the Lord's words, Hanuman was glad: the Lord loves those who come to him for shelter.

first: दो॰—सरनागत कहँ जे तजहिँ, निज अनहित अनुमानि ।
en: 'Those who reject one who seeks shelter, out of fear of harm to themselves, are low and sinful men; even to look at them brings harm.'

first: चौ°—कोटि बिप्रबध लागइ जाहू । आये सरन तजउँ नहि ताहू ॥
en: 'Even one guilty of killing ten million Brahmins I will not reject if he comes for shelter. The moment a soul turns to face me, the sins of ten million births are destroyed.'

first: पापवन्त कर सहज सुभाऊ । भजन मेार तेहि भाव न काऊ॥
en: 'It is the nature of the sinful that they never like to worship me. If he were wicked at heart, would he come before me?'

first: निर्मल लन जन सो मोहि पावा । माहि कपट छल-छिद्र न भावा ॥
en: 'Only one with a pure mind finds me; I do not like deceit, tricks or faults. Even if Ravana has sent him to learn our secrets, monkey king, we have nothing to fear or lose.'

first: जग महँ सखा निसाचर जेते। लछिमन हनइँ निमिष महँ तेते ॥।
en: 'Friend, Lakshmana can kill all the demons in the world in the blink of an eye. And if he has come for shelter in fear, I will guard him like my own life.'

first: दो०-उभय भाँति तेहि आनहु, हँसि कह कृपा-निकेत ।
en: The home of mercy smiled and said, 'Either way, bring him here.' Hearing the merciful Lord, the monkeys went, with Angada and Hanuman.

first: चौ०-सादर तेहि आगे करि बानर । चले जहाँ रघुपति करुनाकर ॥
en: The monkeys respectfully put him in front and went to where the merciful Rama was. From a distance he saw the two brothers, who give joy to the eyes.

first: बहुरि राम छवि-धाम बिलोकी । रहेउ ठठुकि एकटक पल रोकी ।
en: Then, seeing Rama, the home of beauty, he stopped short and gazed without blinking: long arms, eyes like red lotuses, a dark body, the one who frees from fear all who bow to him,

first: सिद्ध कन्ध आयत उर सोहा । आनन अमित मदन मन मोहा ।
en: lion-like shoulders, a broad, fine chest, and a face that charms the heart of countless Love gods. With tears in his eyes and his body thrilling, he steadied his mind and spoke softly:

first: नाथ दसानन कर मैं भ्राता । निसिचर बंस जनम सुरत्राता ।
en: 'Lord, I am Ravana's brother, protector of the gods, born in the demon race. My body is full of darkness and by nature I love sin, as the owl loves the dark.'

first: दो॰—स्रवन सुजस सुनि आयउँ, प्रभु भंजन भव भीर ।
en: 'Hearing of your fame, I have come, Lord, you who end the fear of worldly life. Save me, save me, remover of pain, Rama, who gives joy to those who seek shelter.'

first: चौ°—अस कहि करत दंडवत देखा । तुरत उठे प्रभु हरष बिसेखा ॥
en: Saying this, he fell flat to bow before him. The Lord saw it and rose at once in great joy. Pleased to hear his humble words, he took him in his long arms and hugged him to his heart.

first: अनुज सहित मिलि ढिग बैठारी । बोले बचन भगत भय-हारी
en: He and his brother met him and seated him close. Then Rama, who removes his devotees' fears, said, 'Tell me, lord of Lanka, are you and your family well? You live in a bad place.'

first: खल-मंडली बसहु दिन राती । सखा धरम निबहइ केहि भाँती ॥
en: 'You live day and night among the wicked; friend, how do you keep to what is right? I know all your ways: you are very wise in right conduct and do not like wrongdoing.'

first: बरु भल बास नरक कर ताता। दुष्ट सङ्ग जनि देइ बिधाता ।
en: 'Dear one, better to live in hell than for fate to give one the company of the wicked.' Vibhishana said, 'Rama, now that I see your feet, I am well, since you have shown me kindness, knowing me as your own.'

first: दो॰—तबलगि कुसल न जीव कहुँ ,सपनेहुँ मन बिश्राम॥
en: 'A soul is never well and has no rest for the mind, even in a dream, until it gives up desire, the home of sorrow, and worships Rama.'

first: चौ°—तबलगि हृदय बसत खल नाना । लोभ मोह मत्सर मद माना ॥
en: 'Many wicked ones dwell in the heart, greed, delusion, envy, pride and vanity, only until Rama dwells there, with bow and arrows and quiver at his waist.'

first: चौ°—ममता तरुन तमी अँधियारी। राग द्वेष उलूक सुखकारी॥
en: 'The dark night of attachment, which delights the owls of liking and hatred, stays in the soul's mind only until the sun of the Lord's glory rises.'

first: अब मैं कुसल मिटे भय भारे । देखि राम-पद-कमल तुम्हारे ॥
en: 'Rama, now I am well and my great fears are gone, for I have seen your lotus feet. Merciful one, the three kinds of worldly pain do not touch one whom you favour.'

first: मैँ निसिचर अति अधम सुभाऊ। सुभ आचरन कीन्ह नहिँ काऊ
en: 'I am a demon, very low by nature; I have never done a good deed. Yet the Lord, whose form even sages cannot grasp in meditation, has joyfully hugged me to his heart.'

first: दो०- अहोभाग्य मम अमित अति, राम कृपा सुख पुंज ।
en: 'O my boundless good fortune! Rama, store of grace and joy, I have seen with my own eyes the two lotus feet that Brahma and Shiva worship.'

first: चौ°—सुनहु सखा निज कहउँ सुभाऊ । जान भुसुंडि सम्भु गिरिजाऊँ।
en: Rama said, 'Listen, friend, I will tell you my nature, which Bhushundi, Shiva and Girija know. Even if a man has harmed all beings, if he comes to me for shelter in fear,'

first: तजि मद मोह कपट छल नाना । करउँ सदा तेहि साधु समाना ।
en: 'giving up pride, delusion, deceit and all tricks, I soon make him like a saint. Mother, father, brother, son, wife, body, wealth, home, friends and family:'

first: सब के समता ताग बटोरी । मम पद सनहिँ बाँध बरि डोरी ॥
en: 'whoever gathers the threads of attachment to all these, twists them into a cord, and ties his mind to my feet with it; who sees all alike, has no desires, and has no joy, grief or fear in his mind,'

first: अस सज्जन मम उर बस कैसे । लोभी हृदय बसइ धनु जैसें ॥
en: 'such a good man dwells in my heart as wealth dwells in a miser's heart. Saints like you are dear to me; I take a body for no other reason.'

first: दो०-सगुन उपासक पर-हित, निरत नीति दृढ़ नेम ।
en: 'Those who worship God with form, who are devoted to the good of others, firm in right conduct and their vows, and who love the feet of Brahmins, are as dear to me as life.'

first: चौ°—सुनु लङ्केस सकल गुन तोरें । तातें तुम्ह अतिसय प्रिय मोरें ॥
en: 'Listen, lord of Lanka: you have all these virtues, so you are very dear to me.' Hearing Rama's words, all the monkey troops cried, 'Victory to the store of mercy!'

first: सुनत बिभीषनु प्रभु कै बानी । नहिँ अघात श्रवनामृत जानी ।
en: Hearing the Lord's words, Vibhishana could not have enough of them, finding them nectar to his ears. Again and again he held the Lord's lotus feet; his boundless love could not fit in his heart.

first: सुनहु देव सचराचर स्वामी । प्रनतपाल उर अन्तरजामी ॥
en: 'Listen, Lord, master of all things moving and unmoving, protector of those who bow, who knows every heart. There was some desire in my heart before, but it has been washed away in the river of love for your feet.'

first: अब कृपाल निज भगति पावनी । देहु सदा सिव मन भावनी ॥
en: 'Merciful one, now give me your pure devotion, which always pleases Shiva's heart.' Saying 'So be it,' the Lord, steady in battle, at once asked for water from the sea.

first: जदपि सखा तव इच्छा नाहीँ । मोर दरस अमोघ जग माहीँ ॥
en: 'Friend, though you have no wish for it, the sight of me never goes without fruit in this world.' Saying this, Rama marked his forehead as king, and a great shower of flowers fell from the sky.

first: दो०-रावन क्रोध अनल निज, स्वास समीर प्रचंड।
en: Vibhishana was burning in the fire of Ravana's anger, fanned by the strong wind of his breath; Rama saved him and gave him an unbroken kingdom.

first: जो सम्पति सिव रावनहिँ, दीन्हि दिये दस माथ।
en: The wealth that Shiva gave Ravana when he offered his ten heads, Rama gave that same wealth to Vibhishana, and felt shy that it was so little.

first: चौ°—अस प्रभु छाड़ि भजहिँ जे आना। ते नर पसु बिनु पूँछ विषाना।
en: Those who leave such a Lord and worship another are beasts without tail or horns. Knowing him as his own, Rama took him in, and the Lord's nature pleased the hearts of the monkeys.

first: पुनि सर्वज्ञ सर्व उर बासी । सर्वरूप 'सब रहित उदासी ।
en: Then Rama spoke: he who knows all and dwells in all hearts, who is in every form yet apart from all and unattached, who upholds right conduct, and who for a purpose became man to destroy the demon race.

first: सुनु कपीस लङ्कापति बीरा । केहि बिधि तरिय जलधि गम्भीरा ॥
en: 'Listen, brave monkey king and lord of Lanka: how shall we cross this deep sea, full of crocodiles, snakes and fishes of every kind, very deep and hard to cross in every way?'

first: कह लंकेस सुनहु रघुनायक। कोटि सिन्धु सोषक तब सायक।
en: The lord of Lanka said, 'Listen, Rama: your arrow could dry up ten million oceans. Even so, good conduct says this: go and make a request to the sea.'

first: प्रभु तुम्हार कुलगुर जलधि, कहिहि उपाय बिचारि ।
en: 'Lord, the Ocean is an elder of your family. He will think and tell you a way, and the whole army of bears and monkeys will cross the sea without effort.'

first: चौ°—सखा कही तुम्ह नीकि उपाई। करिय दइव जौँ होइ सहाई ।
en: Rama said, 'Friend, you have told a good way; let us do it, if fate will help.' Lakshmana did not like this advice; he was very upset to hear Rama's words.

first: नाथ दैव कर कवन भरोसा । सोखिय सिन्धु करिय मन रोसा ॥
en: 'Lord, what trust can you put in fate? Get angry and dry up the sea. Fate is the only support of a coward; only the lazy keep crying, fate, fate!'

first: सुनत विहँसि बोले रघुबीरा । ऐसइ करन धरहु मन धीरा॥
en: Hearing this, Rama laughed and said, 'We will do just that; be calm.' Saying this, the Lord calmed his brother and went close to the sea.

first: प्रथम प्रनाम कीन्ह सिर नाई। बैठे पुनि तट दर्भ डसाई ॥
en: First he bowed his head in greeting, then sat on the shore on a mat of sacred grass. When Vibhishana had gone to the Lord, Ravana sent spies after him.

first: दो०-सकल चरित तिन्ह देखे, भरे कपट कपि देह ।
en: Wearing false monkey bodies, they saw everything that happened. In their hearts they praised the Lord's virtues and his love for those who seek shelter.

first: चौ०-प्रगट बखानहिँ राम सुभाऊ । अति सप्रेम गा बिसरि दुराऊ ।।
en: They began to praise Rama's nature openly, and in their great love they forgot their disguise. Then the monkeys knew they were enemy spies, and tied them all up and took them to the monkey king.

first: कह सुग्रीव सुनहु सब बानर । अङ्गभङ्गकरि पठवहु निसिचर ।
en: Sugriva said, 'Listen, all you monkeys: cut off the demons' limbs and send them back.' Hearing Sugriva's words, the monkeys rushed, tied them up and paraded them around the camp.

first: बहु प्रकार मारन कपि लागे । दीन पुकारत तदपि न त्यागे ।
en: The monkeys began beating them in many ways. Even though they cried out pitifully, the monkeys did not let them go. Then the spies cried, 'Whoever cuts our nose and ears, we swear by the Lord of Kosala!'

first: सुनि लछिमल सब निकट बोलाये । दया लागि हँसि तुरत छोड़ाये।
en: Hearing this, Lakshmana called them all near. He took pity, laughed and freed them at once. 'Give this letter to Ravana, and say: destroyer of your family, read Lakshmana's words.'

first: दो०-कहेहु मुखागर मूढ़ सन, मम सन्देस उदार ।
en: 'Also tell that fool my generous message by word of mouth: give back Sita and come to meet Rama, or else your death has come.'

first: चौo-तुरत नाइ लछिमन पद माथा। चले दूत बरनत गुन-गाथा॥
en: At once they bowed their heads at Lakshmana's feet and went off, praising Rama's virtues. Singing Rama's fame, they came to Lanka and bowed their heads at Ravana's feet.

first: बिहँसि दसानन पूछी बाता। कहसि न सुक आपनि कुसलाता।
en: Ravana laughed and asked, 'Shuka, why don't you tell me how you are? Then give me news of Vibhishana, whose death has come very near.'

first: करत राज लङ्का सठ त्यागी। होइहि जव कर कीट अभागी ॥
en: 'The fool left Lanka, where he was ruling; the wretch will be crushed like an insect in barley. Then tell me about the army of bears and monkeys, driven here by cruel Death,'

first: जिन्ह के जीवन कर रखवारा । भयउ मृदुल चित्त सिन्धु बेचारा ।।
en: 'whose lives are guarded by the poor, soft-hearted sea. Then tell me about those hermits, whose hearts are full of fear of me.'

first: की भइ भेंट कि फिरि गये, लवन सुजस सुनि मार ।
en: 'Did you meet them, or did they turn back on hearing of my great fame? Why don't you tell me the strength and might of the enemy army? Your mind looks very shaken.'

first: चौ°—नाथ कृपाकरि पूछेउ जैसे । सानहु कहा क्रोध तजि तैसे ॥
en: Shuka said, 'Lord, since you kindly ask, give up your anger and believe what I say. When your brother went and met him, Rama at once marked his forehead as king.'

first: रावन दूत हलहि सुनि काला । पिन्ह बाँधि दीन्हे दुख नाना ।।
en: 'Hearing we were Ravana's spies, the monkeys tied us up and made us suffer much. They began cutting off our ears and noses; when we swore by Rama, they let us go.'

first: पूछेउ नाथ राम कटकाई । बदन कोटिसत बरनि न जाई।
en: 'Lord, you asked about Rama's army; it cannot be described even with millions of mouths. There are bears and monkeys of many colours, with fierce faces, huge and frightening.'

first: जेहि पुर दहेउ हतेउ सुत तारा । सकल कपिन्ह महँ तेहिबल थोरा ॥
en: 'The one who burned the city and killed your son Akshaya has the least strength of all the monkeys. There are countless named warriors, hard and terrible, with the huge strength of countless elephants.'

first: दो०-द्विबिद मयन्द नील नल, अङ्गदादि बिकटासि ।
en: 'Dvivida, Mainda, Nila, Nala, Angada and other fierce ones, Dadhimukha, Kesari, Kumuda, Gava, and Jambavan, a mass of strength;'

first: चौ०-ये कपिसब सुग्नीव समाना। इन्ह सम कोटिन्ह गनइ को नाना
en: 'all these monkeys are equal to Sugriva, and who can count the millions like them? By Rama's grace they have matchless strength, and think the three worlds no more than straw.'

first: अस मैं स्रवन सुना दसकन्धर । पदुम अठारह यूथप बन्दर ॥
en: 'Ten-headed one, I have heard there are eighteen padmas of monkey troop leaders. Lord, there is no monkey in that army who could not defeat you in battle.'

first: परम क्रोध मीजहिँ सब हाथा । आयसु पै न देहि रघुनाथा
en: 'In great anger they all wring their hands, but Rama does not give them the order. They say they will dry up the sea with its fish and snakes, or else fill it with huge mountains.'

first: मर्दि गर्द मिलवहिँ दससीसा । ऐसइ बचन कहहिँ सब कीसा ॥
en: 'All the monkeys say such things as: we will crush Ravana and grind him into dust. Fearless by nature, they roar and threaten, as if they want to swallow Lanka.'

first: दो०-सहज सूर कपि भालु सब, पुनि सिर पर प्रभु राम ।
en: 'The bears and monkeys are all brave by nature, and on top of that, Lord Rama is their head. Ravana, they could win a battle against ten million Deaths.'

first: चौ०-राम तेज-बल-बुधि बिपुलाई । सेष सहस-सत सकहिँ न गाई ॥
en: 'Even a hundred thousand Sheshas cannot sing the greatness of Rama's glory, strength and wisdom. With a single arrow he could dry up a hundred oceans, yet, being wise in conduct, he asked your brother for advice.'

first: तासु बचन सुनि सागर पाहीँ । माँगत पन्थ कृपा मन माहीँ॥
en: 'On his advice he is asking the sea for a path, with mercy in his heart.' Hearing this, Ravana laughed: 'With such a mind, no wonder he has made monkeys his helpers!'

first: सहज भीरु कर बचन दिढ़ाई । सागर सन ठानी मचलाई ॥
en: 'Trusting the words of one who is a coward by nature, he sulks before the sea like a stubborn child. Fool, why praise him falsely? I have measured the enemy's strength and wisdom.'

first: सचिव सभीत बिभीषन जाके । विजय बिभूति कहा जग ताके ॥
en: 'He whose adviser is the timid Vibhishana, how can he win victory and glory in the world?' Hearing the wicked one's words, the spy grew angry, and seeing the moment had come, he took out the letter.

first: रामानुज दीन्ही यह पाती। नाथ बँचाइ जुड़ावहु छाती।
en: 'Rama's brother gave this letter. Lord, have it read and soothe your heart.' Ravana laughed and took it in his left hand, and the fool called his minister and had it read out.

first: दो°-बातन्ह मनहिं रिझाइ सठ, जनि घालसि कुल खीस ।
en: The letter said: 'Fool, do not please your mind with talk and bring your family to ruin. Opposing Rama, you will not be saved even if you seek shelter with Vishnu, Brahma or Shiva.'

first: की तजि मान अनुज इव, प्रभु-पद-पङ्कज भृङ्ग ।
en: 'Either give up your pride and, like your brother, be a bee at the Lord's lotus feet, or else, wicked one, be a moth in the fire of Rama's arrows, along with your whole family.'

first: चौ°—सुनत सभय मन मुख मुसुकाई। कहत दसानन सबहि सुनाई ॥
en: Hearing it, he was afraid at heart but smiled outwardly, and said aloud for all to hear: 'This little hermit's boasting is like a man lying on the ground trying to grab the sky.'

first: कह सुक नाथ सत्य सब बानी । समुझहु छाडि प्रकृति अभिमानी ।
en: Shuka said, 'Lord, every word of it is true. Understand this, and give up your proud nature. Hear my words, let go of your anger, and give up your enmity with Rama.'

first: अति कोमल रघुबीर सुभाऊ । जदपि अखिल लोक कर राऊ ॥
en: 'Rama's nature is very gentle, though he is king of all the worlds. When you meet him, the Lord will show you grace and will not hold a single fault of yours in his heart.'

first: जनक-सुता रघुनाथहि दोजेै । एतना कहा मोर प्रभु कीजै ।
en: 'Give Janaka's daughter back to Rama; Lord, do just this much that I ask.' When he told him to give up Sita, the fool kicked him.

first: नाइ चरन सिरु चला सो तहाँ। कृपासिन्धु रघुनायक जहाँ ।
en: Shuka bowed his head at Ravana's feet and went to where Rama, the ocean of mercy, was. He bowed, told his story, and by Rama's grace regained his true state.

first: रिषि अगस्ति के साप भवानी । राच्छस भयउ रहा मुनि ज्ञानी ॥
en: Bhavani, he had been a wise sage who became a demon by the curse of the sage Agastya. Bowing again and again at Rama's feet, the sage went back to his hermitage.

first: दो०-बिनय न मानत जलधि जड़, गये तीनि दिन बीति ।
en: Three days passed, but the dull-minded sea did not heed Rama's request. Then Rama said in anger, 'Without fear there is no love.'

first: चौ०-लछिमन बान सरासन आनू । सोखउँ बारिधि बिसिख-कृसानू ॥
en: 'Lakshmana, bring my bow and arrows; I will dry up the sea with the fire of my arrows. Pleading with a fool, love for a crooked man, fine advice to a born miser,'

first: ममता रत सन ज्ञान कहानी । अति लोभी सन बिरति बखानी॥
en: 'talk of wisdom to one lost in attachment, praise of detachment to the very greedy, calm to the angry, and stories of Hari to the lustful are like sowing seed in barren soil.'

first: असकहि रघुपति चाप बढ़ावा । यह मत लछिमन के मन भावा ।
en: Saying this, Rama strung his bow, and Lakshmana was pleased with this plan. The Lord set a fierce arrow to the bow, and a fire flared up deep inside the ocean.

first: मकर उरग झष-गन अकुलाने। जरत जन्तु जलनिधि जब जाने ॥
en: The crocodiles, snakes and shoals of fish were in distress. When the sea saw its creatures burning, it gave up its pride and came in the form of a Brahmin, carrying a golden plate full of many jewels.

first: काटेहि पै कदली फरइ, कोटि जतन कोउ सींच ।
en: Listen, king of birds: a banana plant bears fruit only when it is cut, though one may water it with countless efforts. A low person does not heed pleading; he bends only when scolded.

first: चौ०-सभय सिन्धु गहि पद प्रभु केरे । छमहु नाथ सब अवगुन मेरे ।
en: In fear the Ocean held the Lord's feet: 'Lord, forgive all my faults. Lord, sky, wind, fire, water and earth are by nature dull in their ways.'

first: तव प्रेरित मायाँ उपजाये । सृष्टि हेतु सब ग्रन्थन्हि गाये ॥
en: 'Moved by you, Maya brought them forth for the sake of creation, as all the scriptures say. Each lives happily in the way the Lord has ordered for it.'

first: प्रभु भल कीन्ह मोहि सिख दीन्ही । मरजादा पुनि तुम्हरिय कीन्ही ॥
en: 'Lord, you did well to teach me a lesson, but my limits too were set by you. A drum, a rustic, a shudra, a beast and a woman, all these deserve to be struck,' said the Ocean.

first: प्रभु प्रताप मैँ जांब सुखाई । उत्तरिहि कटक न मारि बड़ाई ॥
en: 'By the Lord's power I would dry up and the army would cross, but that would bring me no honour. Your command cannot be broken, so the Vedas sing; quickly do whatever pleases you.'

first: दो०-सुनत बिनीत बचन अति, कह कृपाल मुसुकाइ।
en: Hearing his very humble words, the merciful Lord smiled and said, 'Friend, tell me a way by which the monkey army can cross.'

first: चौ०-नाथ नील नल कपि दोउ भाई। लरिकाई रिषि आसिष पाई ॥
en: 'Lord, the two monkey brothers Nila and Nala were blessed by a sage in their childhood. Mountains they touch will float on the sea by your glory.'

first: मैं पुनि उर धरि प्रभु प्रभुताई । करिहउँ बल अनुमान सहाई ॥
en: 'And I too, keeping the Lord's might in my heart, will help as much as I can. Lord, in this way have a bridge built over the sea, so that this fine fame is sung in the three worlds.'

first: एहि सर मम उत्तर तट बासी । हतहु नाथ खल नर अघ रासी ।
en: 'With this arrow, Lord, kill the wicked men living on my northern shore, who are heaps of sin.' Hearing this, the merciful Rama, steady in battle, at once removed the Ocean's pain.

first: देखि राम बल पौरुष भारी। हरषि पयोनिधि भयउ सुखारी॥
en: Seeing Rama's great strength and valour, the Ocean was glad and at ease. He told the Lord all that had happened, bowed at his feet and went away.

first: निज भवन गवनेउ सिन्धु श्रीरघुपतिहि यह मत भायऊ ।
en: The Ocean went to his home, and Rama liked his advice. Tulsidas, his servant, has sung this story, which removes the sins of the dark age, as well as he can. The virtues of Rama are the home of joy, the end of doubt and the cure for sorrow; foolish mind, give up every other hope and trust, and always sing and hear them.

first: सकल सुमङ्गल दायक, रघुनायक गुन गान ।
en: Singing of Rama's virtues brings every blessing. Those who hear it with respect will cross the ocean of worldly life without a boat.
